content.title: Is Taylor Frankie Paul’s ‘Bachelorette’ Canceled? Star Breaks Silence On Domestic Violence Investigation
content.text: THE BACHELORETTE - ABC's "The Bacheloretteė stars Taylor Frankie Paul. (Disney/Sami Drasin)DisneyTaylor Frankie Paul’s upcoming season of The Bachelorette is already facing controversy. The reality star recently broke her silence after reports surfaced that she and ex-boyfriend Dakota Mortensen were involved in an alleged domestic violence investigation, as questions continue to swirl about the future of her season.People reported Monday that the mother of three was allegedly involved in a domestic violence investigation with Mortensen and that filming for Season 5 of The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives was halted as a result.Beginning next week, viewers are supposed to watch Paul meet 22 eligible men, go on weekly dates and potentially get engaged at the end of the season. She rose to fame after launching #MomTok, a group of Mormon mothers who create viral social media content while pushing back against traditional church norms. ABC announced Paul as the franchise’s newest lead in September, marking just the second time someone with no prior connection to the series has been chosen to lead The Bachelorette.Forbes‘The Secret Lives Of Mormon Wives’ Season 4: Start Time, How To Watch And What To KnowBy Monica MercuriHowever, her complicated relationship with Mortensen has continued to be a focus on The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives. The most recent fourth season, filmed just before production began on The Bachelorette, revealed that Paul spent the night with Mortensen shortly before departing to film the upcoming season.MORE FOR YOUPaul admitted in a confessional that their night together "doesn’t look the best" in reference to her upcoming role as The Bachelorette. "No matter what, my mistakes, his mistakes, I always come No. 1," Paul said in Season 4 of Mormon Wives. "He always chooses me at the end of the day. So yeah, it does get confusing."What’s Going On With Taylor Frankie Paul And Her Ex Dakota Mortensen?THE SECRET LIVES OF MORMON WIVES - Season 3 - #Momtok is back, but damaging revelations and allegations threaten its future. The members face a crisis of friendship as loyalties shift, trust is tested, and the lines between fact and fiction blur. When the pursuit of the truth calls character into question, a war over morality begins and a clash between #Momtok and #Dadtok erupts. With their sisterhood and everything they've built hanging in the balance, can the women find a path forward to salvation? Or will their collective sins destroy #Momtok for good? (Disney/Natalie Cass)TAYLOR FRANKIE PAUL (Photo by Natalie Cass/Disney via Getty Images)Disney via Getty Images Email Address According to People, Paul and Mortensen were involved in an alleged domestic violence incident in late February that is now under investigation, with a spokesperson for the Draper City Police Department confirming to the outlet that “allegations have been made in both directions.”The spokesperson added that contact was made with the involved parties on Feb. 24 and 25 but declined to provide further details due to the ongoing investigation.Sources also told People that Paul’s MomTok co-stars are reportedly distancing themselves from her. “None of the women want to be associated with her,” one source said.Production on The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives has also allegedly been impacted. “They are not filming,” a source told People. “Taylor has some pretty serious stuff happening regarding her past, and they will see what happens. Until that resolves, they are off.”TMZ was the first outlet to report that production on Season 5 has been paused. “For now, it’s unclear how long production will remain paused or whether cameras will resume rolling soon… but we’re told they’re taking the matter seriously and handling with caution,” the site reported.What Has Taylor Frankie Paul Said About The Situation?The reality star addressed the allegations for the first time during a press preview for her upcoming season of The Bachelorette on Tuesday, March 17."Honestly, just like, my heart hurts to see it, to go through it, especially at this time," Paul told People. “Just the timing is hard, and it's a big deal. I feel like every premiere that I've experienced, I've never enjoyed fully, so this is another one... it's extremely hard, and it took everything to get me here today.”The 31-year-old continued: ”It’s just heavy. It’s a heavy time, and it’s unfortunate. I'm struggling for sure, but also at the same time I feel like if I don't show up, then I'm just giving these opportunities away and not enjoying what we've worked on and something super exciting that's coming. I just feel like it was the right thing to do... show up even though it's hard.”This isn’t Paul’s first run-in with the law. In February 2023, she was arrested and faced misdemeanor charges for “assault, criminal mischief, and commission of domestic violence in the presence of a child,” according to a statement from the Herriman Police Department, cited by People at the time. She was accused of throwing a chair at Mortensen that allegedly struck her daughter, per CBS News.Is The Bachelorette Season 22 Canceled?THE BACHELORETTE - ABC's "The Bacheloretteė stars Taylor Frankie Paul. (Disney/Sami Drasin)DisneyDespite the ongoing investigation, The Bachelorette Season 22 remains on schedule. ABC shared a promotional teaser on Tuesday, March 17, signaling the network is proceeding with the season as planned. However, that could change if backlash against the network intensifies in the coming days.A source told People that some of the men on Paul’s season are "losing their minds over this" behind the scenes. "They’re extremely disappointed. They felt betrayed when they found this out because they all went into this to genuinely get to know Taylor," the source told the outlet. However, another insider told the publication that Paul is “on great terms with the men from The Bachelorette.”Some fans have already taken to social media, calling for Paul’s season to be pulled entirely. “It’s comforting to see that all of the comments are in agreement. Take the loss ABC & move on,” one commenter wrote under ABC’s promo on Instagram. “Why are you promoting a show that involves someone under investigation by child and family services?” another added.“Disappointing that ABC is moving forward with this when there’s an ongoing DV investigation, including child abuse allegations. If anything, it should be put on pause until everything is completed. I hope the network sees these comments and that advertisers pull out,” a third viewer wrote.Representatives for Paul and ABC have not responded to my request for comment.
